kurz: Vanilla pods release their aroma into alcohol. After a few weeks it has become vanilla extract.
bild_im_kopf: Like teabags in cold water: it is slow, but in the end all the aroma is in the jar.
sicherheit: Contains alcohol: for children only in baked cakes, not neat.
ergebnis: About 250 ml of vanilla extract, dark brown and strongly fragrant.
haltbarkeit: Years, dark and sealed. The alcohol preserves it.
material: 250 ml vodka or other spirit with at least 35 % alcohol
dark glass bottle or screw-top jar
verwendung: Cakes, custards, ice cream: about 1 tsp replaces the seeds of half a pod (as a guide).
As a gift in small bottles.

schluesselmomente.schritt: Split the pods lengthways and cut them small
schluesselmomente.warum: More open surface means the aroma gets out faster.

schluesselmomente.schritt: Pour the alcohol over them and seal
schluesselmomente.warum: Vanillin and the other scent compounds dissolve well in alcohol, poorly in water.

schluesselmomente.schritt: Store in the dark and shake once a week
schluesselmomente.warum: Shaking brings fresh alcohol to the pods. Light would destroy aromas.

schluesselmomente.schritt: Use after about 8 weeks, leaving the pods in
schluesselmomente.warum: The longer, the stronger. You can top it up with alcohol.
